scope: One product-observed file whose original condition groups are flat and all have existing excluded error-only first arms.
method: Compare original selectors, group boundaries, else presence and retained else text. Check physical error, selected and following line mappings; conservatively screen comments and conditional continuations. Reject directive after continued physical line.
context: Prior product release builds and 181 retained-guard controls; selector forced on reaches error, so builds using these files cannot silently select these arms.
limits: Reviews conditional structure and alternatives, not unrelated adaptations; the complete inventory of all supported contexts remains open.
